ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade AI health platform featuring remote photoplethysmography (rPPG) heart rate sensing and multilingual triage for rapid rural patient assessment.
ideas.title: MediScan Assist
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages a proven winning formula from similar hackathons by combining computer vision health metrics with localized triage, offering immediate utility for underserved communities that local college judges can easily visualize and test live.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered AML risk detection and investigation platform combining graph intelligence and explainable machine learning for digital commerce security.
ideas.title: FinGuard AML Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adopts the architecture of top-tier hackathon winners by replacing generic transaction alerts with interpretable graph-based fraud investigations that financial compliance judges care about.

ideas.pitch: An engineering team lifecycle intelligence platform that automatically captures contextual tribal knowledge before developers leave and serves it to onboarding members.
ideas.title: DevFlow Lifecycle Intel
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets a pain point experienced by technical judges and student project leads alike: lost developer context during team handovers and project transitions.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness assistant delivering personalized regional meal recommendations and dietary insights tailored to local food availability.
ideas.title: NutriGuide AI
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features a robust, fully working demo with immediate personal consumer appeal, echoing past meal-planning hackathon winners that focused on hyper-localized wellness.

ideas.pitch: A GPS-enabled walk-to-earn community engagement app featuring an AI marketing copilot for local campus shops and a live administrative transparency dashboard.
ideas.title: CivicCatwalk
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates a proven first-place architecture by combining real-world physical engagement (GPS walk metrics) with tangible municipal dashboards that showcase immediate local impact.
